title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. translated_title: DiaCap：联合学习“谁在何时说话”的视听对话字幕生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DiaCap，一个用于全面对话字幕生成的视听大语言模型（LLM），它能为视频中的每一句话生成转录文本、时间戳以及说话人的视觉描述。考虑到话语时间与视听说话人分离（diarization）紧密耦合，DiaCap将这些任务统一在单一模型中，并通过两个互补阶段进行训练。首先，我们在22.5万条精选视频片段上训练DiaCap，使用合成字幕对每一句话进行详尽的密集标注。其次，我们通过强化学习在2.9千条经人工校正的片段上进一步优化模型，使用细粒度反馈直接评估话语时间、说话人分组和说话人绑定。在我们扩展了话语级时间戳和字幕遮蔽功能的DiaDemBench基准上，使用现成转录文本的DiaCap及其端到端变体DiaCap-E2E均取得了强劲的结果。具体而言，DiaCap在视听说话人分离任务上的表现与Gemini 4 Argon相当。
tldr: DiaCap是一个统一的视听大语言模型，通过合成数据预训练与强化学习微调两个互补阶段，联合学习话语时间戳、视听说话人分离与说话人绑定，为视频中每句话生成转录、时间戳和说话人外观描述，实现全面的对话字幕生成。
en_tdlr: DiaCap is a unified audiovisual LLM trained through two complementary stages—synthetic pretraining and reinforcement learning—that jointly learns utterance timing, audiovisual diarization, and speaker binding to produce transcripts, timestamps, and speaker visual descriptions for comprehensive dialogue captioning.
